newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE9.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE9.

text.p: These are the main headlines of the news stories reported by Radio Latvia on Monday in the early afternoon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- The release of Ivan Haritonov, alleged organised crime leader, after three years of investigation, is a sign of inefficiency on behalf of Latvia's judiciary, said Ziedonis Chevers, head of Democratic Party Saimnieks.
- A joint Baltic stance on NATO expansion ahead of the July Madrid summit will be coordinated at a meeting of Baltic and Nordic defence ministers on the Estonian island of Saaremaa.
